_about: Cost and readiness parameters. Change any value and re-run; nothing in the code repeats these numbers.
_price_note: Example price for the exercise only — not an approved ChiSensor price.
_commission_note: Store commission on kept sales; reversed on a full refund. Tax and FX ignored.

production_hours_by_channel._source: ASSUMPTION — production hours are not in the input data. These placeholders are shown as assumptions in the report; replace them with real timesheet hours.

next_trial._note: Upper limit for the next 14-day experiments, not a target to spend.

_cutoff_note: null = latest event timestamp. Events after the cutoff are ignored (a later refund is not 'known').

readiness._note: Given readiness flag. While false, experiment cards stay BLOCKED (draft only). Even when true, cards stay BLOCKED if the data still shows undelivered or pending payments.
